heading:
Organizing what I see, think, and create —
a wish for any life, now or in the future.
intro_points: From the outside, you, me, a fish, a bird — we may look like statistical units;
but inside every conscious nervous system, feeling and thought are the entire shape of the present world.
When the eyes close, everything disappears.
That fundamental isolation lives inside each individual. A bystander can only guess, draw close, respond — never live it for anyone else.
So while consciousness is here, I want to share what's worth sharing with the lives I touch.
I wish every life to be self-coherent in this world — that is: a place where you feel at ease, an ideal you can keep pursuing, and the means to keep yourself alive.
If anything I made helps your life in some small way, that's the largest, purest joy I know.
